records.source: It's raining outside. Make sure you don't catch cold, dear.#$e#Stay indoors as much as possible.$h#$e#I worry about you sometimes!
records.translation: Umuulan sa labas. Tiyaking hindi ka magkasipon, mahal.#$e#Manatili ka sa loob hangga't maaari.$h#$e#Nag-aalala ako sa iyo kung minsan!

records.source: It's raining! That means we don't have to water the crops today.$h#$e#Nature can be a big help sometimes.#$e#Have you fed the animals yet, honey?
records.translation: Umuulan! Ibig sabihin, hindi natin kailangang diligan ang mga pananim ngayon.$h#$e#Malaking tulong talaga ang kalikasan kung minsan.#$e#Napakain mo na ba ang mga hayop, mahal?

records.source: Good morning! I woke up early from the sound of the rain and made you some breakfast. [194 195 210 211 216]  #$e#Stay warm and don't work too hard. I want you to stay healthy.
records.translation: Magandang umaga! Maaga akong nagising sa tunog ng ulan at ipinaghanda kita ng almusal. [194 195 210 211 216]  #$e#Huwag kang magpalamig at huwag masyadong magpakapagod. Gusto kong manatili kang malusog.

records.source: What's on your agenda today, dear?#$e#I don't want to go outside in this weather... I'll just do some things around the house.#$e#Maybe I'll make something hot for dinner.
records.translation: Ano ang balak mo ngayon, mahal?#$e#Ayokong lumabas sa ganitong panahon... May aasikasuhin na lang ako sa bahay.#$e#Baka magluto ako ng mainit na pagkain para sa hapunan.

records.source: Any dinner requests for tonight?
records.translation: May hiling ka ba para sa hapunan ngayong gabi?

records.source: Despite all the technology we have, a rainy day is still the best tool for watering crops.
records.translation: Sa kabila ng lahat ng teknolohiyang mayroon tayo, ulan pa rin ang pinakamahusay na pandilig sa mga pananim.

records.source: The countryside looks more interesting on a day like this, don't you think?
records.translation: Mas kawili-wili ang kabukiran sa ganitong araw, hindi ba?

records.source: I think I might do some baking today.$h
records.translation: Baka maghurno ako ngayon.$h

records.source: Might want to do some fishing or mining today, huh?
records.translation: Baka gusto mong mangisda o magmina ngayon, ano?

records.source: Hmmph. If this weather keeps up I'll get too pale.$s
records.translation: Hmph. Kapag nagpatuloy ang ganitong panahon, mamumutla ako nang husto.$s

records.source: Make sure you stay dry today, dear. I don't want you to become hypothermic.
records.translation: Tiyaking hindi ka mababasa ngayon, mahal. Ayokong magkaroon ka ng hipotermiya.

records.source: I got up just before dawn and took a walk around the farm. It's really peaceful at that hour.
records.translation: Bumangon ako bago magbukang-liwayway at naglakad-lakad sa bukid. Napakatahimik talaga sa ganoong oras.

records.source: Hmm... I guess I'll have to do push-ups and sit-ups indoors today.
records.translation: Hmm... Mukhang sa loob muna ako magpu-push-up at magse-sit-up ngayon.

records.source: The rain makes me think of my old life by the ocean.#$e#Change is part of life. That's okay.
records.translation: Ipinapaalala sa akin ng ulan ang dati kong buhay sa tabi ng karagatan.#$e#Bahagi ng buhay ang pagbabago. Ayos lang iyon.

records.source: I might spend some time today fixing any leaks in the roof or the windows.
records.translation: Baka maglaan ako ng oras ngayon para kumpunihin ang anumang tagas sa bubong o mga bintana.

records.source: I know you pride yourself on your work, but don't overdo it today. Okay, honey?$u
records.translation: Alam kong ipinagmamalaki mo ang trabaho mo, pero huwag mo itong sosobrahan ngayon. Sige, mahal?$u

records.source: The roof's leaking? Ah well... a little mold never hurt anyone.
records.translation: Tumutulo ang bubong? Ah, ayos lang... Wala namang napahamak sa kaunting amag.

records.source: The rain makes it feel like we're all alone.$l#$e#I'm cold... Aren't you ready to tuck into bed?$l
records.translation: Dahil sa ulan, parang tayong dalawa lang ang narito.$l#$e#Nilalamig ako... Hindi ka pa ba handang humiga na tayo?$l

records.source: Make sure you change into something warm. I don't want you to get sick.#$e#Can you hear the rain pattering on the roof, @?
records.translation: Tiyaking magpalit ka ng mas mainit na damit. Ayokong magkasakit ka.#$e#Naririnig mo ba ang lagaslas ng ulan sa bubong, @?

records.source: Ah...The soothing sound of rain overhead... I'm going to sleep well tonight.$h
records.translation: Ah... Ang nakapapawing tunog ng ulan sa bubong... Mahimbing ang magiging tulog ko ngayong gabi.$h

records.source: The rain makes our home seem so cozy.$h^It's nights like this I'm glad we have a quality roof.
records.translation: Dahil sa ulan, parang napakaginhawa ng tahanan natin.$h^Sa mga gabing ganito, natutuwa akong de-kalidad ang bubong natin.

records.source: I made some soup for dinner. [199 218 219 727 730]$h#$e#You need something hot on a day like this!$h
records.translation: Nagluto ako ng sopas para sa hapunan. [199 218 219 727 730]$h#$e#Kailangan mo ng mainit na pagkain sa ganitong araw!$h

records.source: I'm glad you're home... It's a good night to stay inside.
records.translation: Natutuwa akong nakauwi ka na... Angkop ang gabing ito para manatili sa loob.

records.source: Were you able to accomplish much today, hun?#$e#I tried to fix up some things around the house... you know, just little stuff.
records.translation: Marami ka bang nagawa ngayon, mahal?#$e#Sinubukan kong ayusin ang ilang bagay sa bahay... alam mo na, maliliit na bagay lang.

records.source: I'm ready to hop into bed whenever you are. The sound of rain will put us right to sleep.
records.translation: Handa na akong humiga kapag handa ka na. Makatutulog agad tayo sa tunog ng ulan.

records.source: Oh... the smell? I tried to do some baking... It didn't work out too well.$s
records.translation: Ah... ang amoy? Sinubukan kong maghurno... Hindi gaanong naging maayos.$s

records.source: How was your day today, dear? Muddy?
records.translation: Kumusta ang araw mo, mahal? Maputik?

records.source: Hi, honey. I'm so glad you're home. I was starting to get kind of lonely.$l
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal. Natutuwa akong nakauwi ka na. Nagsisimula na akong malungkot nang kaunti.$l

records.source: Hi. It's good to see you.$h#$e#I spent the day skimming through some medical journals.
records.translation: Kumusta. Masaya akong makita ka.$h#$e#Buong araw akong nagbasa-basa ng mga medikal na journal.

records.source: I'll never grow tired of the rain... especially out here in the countryside.
records.translation: Hindi ako magsasawa sa ulan... lalo na rito sa kabukiran.

records.source: Grandma always used to make hot stew on nights like this.$h
records.translation: Laging nagluluto si Lola ng mainit na nilaga sa mga gabing ganito.$h

records.source: Sit down, relax! You've got to be tired after trudging through the mud all day.
records.translation: Maupo ka at magpahinga! Siguradong pagod ka matapos maglakad sa putik buong araw.

records.source: Vincent called. He said he misses me and also to tell you hi.$h
records.translation: Tumawag si Vincent. Sabi niya, hinahanap-hanap niya ako at binabati ka rin niya.$h

records.source: I just got off the phone with Jas and Marnie. They seem to be having a pretty good time without me.
records.translation: Katatapos ko lang makipag-usap sa telepono kina Jas at Marnie. Mukhang masayang-masaya naman sila kahit wala ako.

records.source: Certain spirits only appear in the rain. Maybe you've heard their cries?
records.translation: May ilang espiritung lumilitaw lamang kapag umuulan. Baka narinig mo na ang kanilang mga daing?

records.source: Good morning ~<$h#$e#Ready for a hard day's work? I am.$h
records.translation: Magandang umaga ~<$h#$e#Handa ka na ba sa isang araw ng puspusang trabaho? Ako, handa na.$h

records.source: Hi, honey! Smells good, doesn't it? I made you breakfast! [194 195 210 211 216]#$e#You need food to stay energized throughout the day.
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal! Mabango, hindi ba? Ipinaghanda kita ng almusal! [194 195 210 211 216]#$e#Kailangan mong kumain para manatili kang masigla buong araw.

records.source: Did you sleep well?#$e#I've got some chores to do in here.
records.translation: Mahimbing ba ang tulog mo?#$e#May ilang gawaing-bahay akong aasikasuhin dito.

records.source: Did you have any strange dreams last night?#$e#I did, but all I remember is that it had something to do with a %adj %noun. Weird.$s#$e#Hehe. Dreams don't mean anything... do they, Honey?$l#$e#Well, we can't spend all day chit-chatting. You have work to do!
records.translation: May kakaiba ka bang panaginip kagabi?#$e#Ako, mayroon, pero ang natatandaan ko lang ay may kinalaman iyon sa isang %adj %noun. Kakaiba.$s#$e#Hehe. Walang ibig sabihin ang mga panaginip... hindi ba, mahal?$l#$e#Pero hindi tayo maaaring magkuwentuhan buong araw. May trabaho ka pa!

records.source: Good morning, dear. Another day of farm chores, huh?#$e#I'll be cheering for you. <$h
records.translation: Magandang umaga, mahal. Panibagong araw na naman ng mga gawain sa bukid, ano?#$e#Hihikayatin kita. <$h

records.source: If you ever want to talk about how to maximize crop yield or anything... I'm open to that!
records.translation: Kung gusto mong pag-usapan kung paano paramihin nang husto ang ani o anupaman... handa akong pag-usapan iyon!

records.source: There's always something new happening on our farm... I love it.
records.translation: Laging may bagong nangyayari sa bukid natin... Gustung-gusto ko ito.

records.source: This place is so big compared to the trailer, I feel overwhelmed... In a good way!
records.translation: Napakalaki ng lugar na ito kumpara sa treyler, kaya parang hindi ko alam ang uunahin... Pero sa magandang paraan!

records.source: Mind if I add some architectural flair to the woodwork around here? My chisel hand is itching!
records.translation: Ayos lang bang lagyan ko ng kaunting artistikong detalye ang mga gawaing-kahoy dito? Nangangati na ang kamay kong humawak ng pait!

records.source: I always feel happy on a sunny day.$h
records.translation: Lagi akong masaya kapag maaraw.$h

records.source: The sky looks great today... so clear!#$e#From now on, I'm only going to go into the clinic when I have appointments. Otherwise I can just work from home!
records.translation: Napakaganda ng langit ngayon... napakalinaw!#$e#Mula ngayon, pupunta lang ako sa klinika kapag may mga pasyente akong naka-iskedyul. Kung wala, maaari akong magtrabaho mula sa bahay!

records.source: Well, this place sure beats my old basement room, doesn't it?$h
records.translation: Mas maganda talaga ang lugar na ito kaysa sa dati kong silid sa silong, hindi ba?$h

records.source: The sun's shining and I'm bursting with energy! You'd better watch out! Heh Heh.$h
records.translation: Sumisikat ang araw at nag-uumapaw ako sa enerhiya! Humanda ka! Heh heh.$h

records.source: I've been keeping a journal ever since we moved in together. Now that I actually have a life, I have lots to write about.$h#$e#I want to make sure I always remember these years.
records.translation: Nagsusulat ako sa journal mula nang magsama tayo rito. Ngayong may maikukuwento na talaga ako tungkol sa buhay, marami na akong maisusulat.$h#$e#Gusto kong tiyaking lagi kong maaalala ang mga panahong ito.

records.source: There's too much stuff I want to get done today... Maybe I'll just watch TV instead.
records.translation: Napakarami kong gustong tapusin ngayon... Baka manood na lang ako ng telebisyon.

records.source: By providing fresh, healthy produce to the community, we're doing a great service!
records.translation: Malaki ang naitutulong natin sa komunidad sa pagbibigay ng sariwa at masustansiyang ani!

records.source: There's something special in the air... *sniff*... what is that? Oh...#$b#It's just this old corn chip I put in my pocket a few weeks ago. *crunch*
records.translation: May kakaiba sa hangin... *singhot*... ano iyon? Ah...#$b#Lumang tsitsiryang mais lang pala na inilagay ko sa bulsa ko ilang linggo na ang nakararaan. *langutngot*

records.source: Did you get everything done today, @?#$e#I did some house chores... but now I'm so tired.#$e#I'm ready for bed whenever you are.$h
records.translation: Natapos mo ba ang lahat ngayon, @?#$e#May ginawa akong ilang gawaing-bahay... pero pagod na pagod na ako.#$e#Handa na akong matulog kapag handa ka na.$h

records.source: Wow, you look like you did a lot of work today.#$e#Now you should just relax and kick back for the night.$h
records.translation: Wow, mukhang marami kang ginawa ngayon.#$e#Ngayon, magpahinga ka na lang at magrelaks ngayong gabi.$h

records.source: I'm glad you're home.#$e#I get kind of scared alone at night.$s^I get lonely at night...$s#$e#...$h
records.translation: Natutuwa akong nakauwi ka na.#$e#Medyo natatakot ako kapag mag-isa sa gabi.$s^Nalulungkot ako sa gabi...$s#$e#...$h

records.source: Are you done with your work for the day? I'm ready to have some fun.$h#$e#But if you're tired I understand.
records.translation: Tapos ka na ba sa trabaho mo ngayong araw? Handa na akong magsaya.$h#$e#Pero mauunawaan ko kung pagod ka.

records.source: *phew*! I just finished my chores. Now we can spend some time together.$h#$e#So, tell me about your day.$l#$e#...$h
records.translation: *Hay*! Katatapos ko lang sa mga gawain ko. Maaari na tayong maglaan ng oras sa isa't isa.$h#$e#Kung gayon, ikuwento mo sa akin ang araw mo.$l#$e#...$h

records.source: You look like you're ready for bed, @. Should I lull you to sleep with the technical details of my latest project?$h#$e#*yawn*... To be honest, I'm kind of sleepy too.
records.translation: Mukhang handa ka nang matulog, @. Gusto mo bang patulugin kita sa mga teknikal na detalye ng pinakabago kong proyekto?$h#$e#*hikab*... Sa totoo lang, medyo inaantok na rin ako.

records.source: Are you ready for bed soon? I turned on the electric blanket for us...$l
records.translation: Malapit ka na bang matulog? Binuksan ko na ang de-kuryenteng kumot para sa atin...$l

records.source: Hi there, honey. Ready to spend a quiet evening at home?
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal. Handa ka na ba sa isang tahimik na gabi sa bahay?

records.source: It's so quiet and peaceful in the evening. Nothing to distract you from the experience of living.
records.translation: Napakatahimik at payapa sa gabi. Walang gumagambala sa mismong karanasan ng pamumuhay.

records.source: You look like you've been working hard, dear. Let me help you de-stress.$l
records.translation: Mukhang nagsikap ka nang husto, mahal. Tulungan kitang maibsan ang pagod mo.$l

records.source: You look like you could use a good massage tonight.$l#$e#Doctor's orders... It's good for the circulation!
records.translation: Mukhang kailangan mo ng magandang masahe ngayong gabi.$l#$e#Utos ng doktor... Mabuti ito sa sirkulasyon!

records.source: #$c .5#I may be a reclusive guy, but I'm always happy when you're around.$h#$e#Hi, @. Good to see you. It's comforting when you're around.$h
records.translation: #$c .5#Mahilig man akong magkulong sa sarili, lagi akong masaya kapag narito ka.$h#$e#Kumusta, @. Mabuti at nakita kita. Panatag ako kapag narito ka.$h

records.source: My arms feel a little restless... How about a nice, deep massage?$l^I feel exhausted... That's a good sign! It means I worked hard enough today.$h
records.translation: Parang hindi mapakali ang mga braso ko... Maaari mo ba akong bigyan ng masarap at madiing masahe?$l^Pagod na pagod ako... Magandang senyales iyan! Ibig sabihin, sapat ang pagsisikap ko ngayon.$h

records.source: #$c .5#You always smell so good after a day of hard work. It's your natural musk!^You smell sweet, my dear. Like a honeycomb drifting on a pool of spice tea.#$e#Come here, let me massage your back. You look tense.$l^You smell sweet, my dear. Like a cinnamon leaf floating in the summer breeze.
records.translation: #$c .5#Napakabango mo lagi matapos ang isang araw ng puspusang trabaho. Likas mong halimuyak iyon!^Matamis ang bango mo, mahal ko. Parang pulot-pukyutang lumulutang sa tsaang may mga rekado.#$e#Halika, imasahe ko ang likod mo. Mukhang naninigas ang mga kalamnan mo.$l^Matamis ang bango mo, mahal ko. Parang dahon ng kanela na lumulutang sa simoy ng tag-init.

records.source: #$c .5#I wonder if the moon is visible tonight?#$e#So, did you get everything done on the farm today? If you didn't I won't be mad!
records.translation: #$c .5#Nakikita kaya ang buwan ngayong gabi?#$e#Kung gayon, natapos mo ba ang lahat sa bukid ngayon? Hindi ako magagalit kung hindi!

records.source: It's a very cozy house... I like it.
records.translation: Napakaginhawa ng bahay... Gusto ko rito.

records.source: How was your day? Mine actually went pretty well.
records.translation: Kumusta ang araw mo? Naging maayos naman ang araw ko.

records.source: It's a beautiful day today, isn't it?$h#$e#Days like this make work a little more pleasant.
records.translation: Napakaganda ng araw ngayon, hindi ba?$h#$e#Mas magaan nang kaunti ang trabaho sa mga araw na ganito.

records.source: I'm just going to relax and inspect the farm today, okay?#$e#It's just such a nice-looking area.$h
records.translation: Magpapahinga at maglilibot lang ako upang tingnan ang bukid ngayon, ayos lang?#$e#Napakaganda kasi talaga ng lugar na ito.$h
